title: Prepared Collection Kit on Late Changes — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
*Specimen logistics schedule — Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, Specimen Collection Appointments.*

When a home visit is changed late, the collection kit for its order has already been prepared. The kit amount follows the service class of the order the visit is to collect, as the order's record in Laboratory Test Orders shows that class.

| Service class of the order | Prepared-kit amount added (USD) |
|---|---|
| Esoteric Reference Testing | 15.00 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | 15.00 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | 8.00 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | 8.00 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | 8.00 |
| Routine Clinical Testing; Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | Nothing |

**Clause.** A visit collecting an order of the Esoteric Reference Testing or Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing class adds 15.00 for the kit already prepared, one collecting an order of the Specialty Clinical Testing, Molecular Infectious Disease Testing or Clinical Toxicology Testing class adds 8.00, and one collecting any other class adds nothing.

**Reading (hypothetical).** A late change to a visit collecting a Specialty Clinical Testing order: 8.00 added.
